components.name: Godot Engine 4.7.2
components.description: Pinned standard Godot editor for 2D and 3D game development. Uses the OpenGL Compatibility renderer in VibeStack.
next_steps: Open Godot Engine from the desktop and create or import a project.
Install export templates from Godot only for the target platforms you need.

components.name: Flatpak + Flathub marketplace
components.description: Per-user Flatpak apps from stable Flathub, with XFCE portal and menu integration. Requires VibeStack's explicit --flatpak nested-sandbox mode.
components.probe: command -v flatpak >/dev/null && command -v bwrap >/dev/null && test "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${db:Status-Abbrev}' xdg-desktop-portal-xapp 2>/dev/null)" = 'ii ' && flatpak --user remotes --columns=name,url | awk '$1 == "flathub" && $2 == "https://dl.flathub.org/repo/" { found=1 } END { exit !found }'
next_steps: Open Flathub Marketplace from the VibeStack menu, or run vibestack-flatpak search <terms>.
Review the exact app ID, publisher verification, and permissions before installing third-party code.
